Modulate the amount of mic input to reduce its volume when it gets too loud. The following properties can be adjusted from here:

Threshold
Sets when the compressor will engage. Any sound that registers above the threshold will be reduced or muted.

Gain
Increases the volume of the processed output to maintain its definition even after compression.

Ratio
Sets the intensity of the compression.

Attack
Determines how quickly the compression will engage if the mic input registers above the threshold.

Release
Determines how fast the mic input will be compressed.
EFFECTS_NOISE_GATE_TOOLTIP:
Control the amount of mic input to cut out background noise and completely isolate your voice. The following properties can be adjusted:

Threshold
Sets when the Noise Gate will open. Any sound that registers below the threshold will be reduced or muted.

Reduction
The amount of reduction or muting of sound if the mic input registers below the threshold.

Attack
Determines how quickly the noise gate will be opened if the mic input registers below the threshold.

Release
Determines how fast the mic input will be reduced.
